rejection.title: Rejection reason
rejection.legacyMigrationNote: This record was closed during migration from the old validation policy to the new one. This does not mean the photo was judged inappropriate by AI.

codes.LEGACY_POLICY_RESET: This record was closed during migration from the old validation policy to the new one. This does not mean the photo was judged inappropriate by AI.
codes.CLEARLY_UNRELATED_CONTENT: The photo does not appear related to a parking space or road context.
codes.INDOOR_SCENE: The photo was rejected because it shows an indoor scene.
codes.SELFIE_OR_PERSONAL_PHOTO: The photo contains a personal image rather than a parking space.
codes.FOOD_OR_RANDOM_OBJECT: The photo shows food or an unrelated object rather than parking.
codes.SCREENSHOT_OR_DOCUMENT: The photo was rejected because it is a screenshot or document.
codes.NO_ROAD_OR_PARKING_CONTEXT: No road or parking context could be identified in the image.
codes.UNUSABLE_IMAGE: The image is not usable enough for validation.
codes.IMAGE_TOO_DARK: The photo is too dark to evaluate.
codes.IMAGE_TOO_BLURRY: The photo is too blurry to evaluate.
codes.IMAGE_CORRUPTED: The image is corrupted or unreadable.
codes.LEGALITY_CONCERN: The submission was rejected due to a legality or access concern.
codes.DUPLICATE_SUBMISSION: The submission was rejected as a duplicate.
codes.MANUAL_MODERATOR_REJECTION: The submission was rejected by a moderator.
codes.OTHER: The submission was rejected under the validation policy.
codes.UNKNOWN: The submission was rejected under the validation policy.

subtitle.SYSTEM_MIGRATION: This submission was closed as part of the migration to the new validation policy. It was NOT rejected because of image quality.
